excerpt: Disney's Q1 FY26 earnings showed a 5% revenue increase to $26 billion, but segment operating income declined 9% to $4.6 billion. SVOD revenue grew 11%, while advertising revenue dropped 6%.

content.introduction: Disney's Q1 FY26 earnings showed a 5% revenue increase to $26 billion, but segment operating income declined 9% to $4.6 billion. SVOD revenue grew 11%, while advertising revenue dropped 6%.
body: * Revenues increased 5% for the quarter to $26.0 billion from $24.7 billion in Q1 fiscal 2025. * Total segment operating income (1) decreased 9% for the quarter to $4.6 billion from $5.1 billion in Q1 fiscal 2025. Operating income (OI) declined $0.6 billion to $1.1 billion, resulting in Entertainment segment operating margin of 9.5%, as higher programming and production and marketing costs in the quarter more than offset an increase in subscription and affiliate fees and higher theatrical revenue. + SVOD (2) revenue increased 11% compared to Q1 fiscal 2025 (growth reflects a 1 ppt adverse impact from the inclusion of Star India revenue in the prior-year quarter). + Segment advertising revenue decreased 6% compared to Q1 fiscal 2025, and reflects a net adverse impact of 11 ppts from the inclusion of Star India and higher political advertising in Q1 fiscal 2025 and Fubo in Q1 fiscal 2026.
